entities.summary: Nathalie Azoulai is a French writer. She was born on September 9, 1966. She studied at the École Normale Supérieure, and currently lives in Paris. The author of several books, she is best known for her novel Titus n’aimait pas Bérénice which won the Prix Médicis in 2015.
